title: 第25章 杀手第26章 天煞诀
content_zh:
“向军！你给我死一边去！”
孟晶一脚将这个自作主张的小胖子踢到一旁。
“我的对手，我要亲自解决，江平安，拔刀吧！”
“我不想……”
江平安刚要说什么，忽然察觉到了什么，冲向孟晶，一把将其抱住跳开。
“你干嘛，起开！”
孟晶小脸变红，娇声大喝，第一次被外人抱住，很不好意思。
不过，她忽然注意到了什么，脸色一变。
一柄飞镖落在她刚才所在的地方。
与此同时，突然出现一道金光，将周围覆盖。
四道人影不知道何时从四面涌来，一起进入到了金光之中。
“灵气罩！！”
小胖子向军愣了片刻，脸色大变，迅速往外冲去。
灵气罩是用来困住敌人的，现在出现飞镖与这东西，显然来者不善！
向军反应还是慢了，身体撞在灵气罩上，重重弹了回来。
突如其来的一幕让三人心情一沉。
“哈哈，运气真好，一下子遇到三个刺杀目标，这次赚大了！”
一个披着黑袍的人阴森开口。
“别废话，速战速决！”
一个黑袍人迅速发布命令，四人非常利索地杀向三个孩子。

“是杀手！”向军吓得大惊失色，抬起手结印，准备施展火焰诀迎击。
但就在这一刻，四人身上突然迸发出一股阴森恐怖的煞气，一道道惨死的修士虚影出现在虚空中。
这股气息宛若一条冰冷的蛇，直接钻入向军心头，让他身体发僵，宛若进入寒冬。
前所未有的恐惧在内心翻涌，身体颤抖，无法动弹，施法被打断。
孟晶也想提刀迎击，但这股恐怖的煞气让她身体僵直，影响了身体行动。
“天煞诀……天煞阁刺客……”
孟晶脸上浮现出绝望，父亲之前就被这些刺客袭击过，所以她认出了对方的身份。
他天煞阁是最强刺客组织，里面的专职杀手都修炼《天煞诀》。
天煞诀，一种通过杀人培养煞气的术法，施展之后，能够提高战意，并能影响其他修士精神。
杀的人越多，这群人身上的煞气就越强，对人的影响就越大。
这四个人本就是练气六七层的水平，加上这煞气，战力更是恐怖。
小胖子向军听到“天煞阁”三个字，神情呆滞，完全放弃了抵抗，准备死亡。
别说一次来了四个刺客，就是来一个天煞阁刺客，他们也挡不住。
更何况外面还有灵气罩，阻挡逃跑。
四人挥剑，向着三个少年的脖子抹去，黑袍下的面孔中充满了贪婪。
本来他们是接了刺杀江平安的任务，没想到一次遇到三个人。
这三个人都在任务悬赏栏上。
什么狗屁天才，就算再天才，面对绝对实力也要死！
寒光闪烁，鲜血飘洒。
恐怖的煞气和那些惨死的修士虚影消失。

四人捂着脖子，难以置信地看向江平安。
“你……你不是练气五层……”
content_en:
"Xiang Jun! Just die!"
Meng Jing kicked the fat man aside.
"I want to deal with my opponent myself. Jiang Ping'an, draw your sword!"
"I don't want to..."
Just as Jiang Ping'an was about to say something, he suddenly noticed something and rushed towards Meng Jing, hugged her and jumped away.
"What are you doing? Get up and drive!"
Meng Jing's face turned red and she yelled. She was very embarrassed to be hugged by an outsider for the first time.
However, she suddenly noticed something and her expression changed.
A dart landed where she had just been.
At the same time, a golden light suddenly appeared, covering the surrounding area.
Four figures came from all directions and entered the golden light together.
"Aura cover!!"
The little fat man Xiang Jun was stunned for a moment, his expression changed drastically, and he quickly rushed out.
The aura shield is used to trap the enemy. Now that darts and these things appear, it is obvious that the attacker is evil!
Xiang Jun's reaction was still slow. His body hit the spiritual energy shield and bounced back hard.
The sudden scene made the three of them feel depressed.
"Haha, I'm so lucky. I met three assassination targets at once. I made a lot of money this time!"
A man in a black robe spoke grimly.
"Stop talking nonsense and fight quickly!"
A man in black robe quickly issued an order, and the four of them killed the three children very neatly.
"It's the killer!" Xiang Jun was so frightened that he raised his hand to form a seal, preparing to use the Flame Technique to attack.
But at this moment, a ghastly evil energy suddenly burst out from the four people, and the phantoms of the monks who died tragically appeared in the void.
This breath was like a cold snake, piercing directly into Xiang Jun's heart, making his body stiff, as if he was entering the cold winter.
Unprecedented fear surged in his heart, his body trembled, he could not move, and his spell casting was interrupted.
Meng Jing also wanted to raise her knife to fight, but the terrifying evil spirit made her body stiff and affected her body movements.
"Tiansha Jue...Tiansha Pavilion Assassin..."
Desperation appeared on Meng Jing's face. Her father had been attacked by these assassins before, so she recognized the identity of the other party.
Tiansha Pavilion is the strongest assassin organization, and all the professional assassins in it practice "Tiansha Jue".
Tiansha Jue is a technique that cultivates evil spirits through killing people. After being used, it can increase fighting spirit and affect the spirits of other monks.
The more people are killed, the stronger the evil spirit of this group of people is, and the greater the impact on people.
These four people are already at the sixth or seventh level of Qi training. With this evil energy, their combat power is even more terrifying.
When the little fat man Xiang Jun heard the three words "Tiansha Pavilion", his expression was dull, he completely gave up resistance and prepared to die.
Not to mention four assassins coming at once, even if one Tiansha Pavilion assassin comes, they can't stop them.
What's more, there is a spiritual energy shield outside to block escape.
The four of them swung their swords towards the necks of the three young men, their faces under the black robes full of greed.
Originally, they took over the task of assassinating Jiang Ping'an, but they didn't expect to encounter three people at once.
All three are on the mission bounty list.
What kind of bullshit genius? No matter how talented you are, you will die in the face of absolute strength!
Cold light flashed and blood flowed.
The terrifying evil spirit and the phantoms of the monks who died tragically disappeared.
The four of them covered their necks and looked at Jiang Pingan in disbelief.
"You...you are not at the fifth level of Qi training..."
